title: What Really Caused the 1908 Tunguska Blast?

scenes.text: June 30, 1908: a 5‑megaton flash flattened 2,000 km² of forest

scenes.label: Alien crash theory
scenes.text: Many claim a crashed alien spacecraft caused the explosion

scenes.label: Meteoroid airburst
scenes.text: Current consensus: an airburst of a meteoroid or comet fragment, no impact crater

scenes.label: Shockwave only
scenes.sub: Evidence points to an atmospheric explosion
scenes.text: No wreckage found—just a massive shockwave
Follow if the unknown keeps you up at night.

description: The Tunguska event remains one of Earth’s biggest mysteries. Learn why scientists favor a meteoroid airburst over alien tech. Follow for more cosmic mysteries.
